text:
maria: Hey team — proposing Bluecrest private rollout during the quiet window Thu 2025-06-12 22:00 UTC. Need KMS pin + version pin + final sign-off. Ping @devon @ana

devon: I can take lead. Plan: pin infra at v2.14.3 and model variant r-quant-8. Canary 3% for 15m then 25% for 15m. Fallback to r-fp16 on high mem usage.

deploybot: [deploybot] Scheduled: bluecrest/private-rollout — start=2025-06-12T22:00:00Z approver=maria owner=devon

ana: Confirming model pin — v2.14.3 uses kernel set k1. Should we disable async batching for initial canary?

devon: Let's keep batching=on but limit max_batch_size=8. Quick config:
```yaml
model_pin: r-quant-8
infra_version: v2.14.3
canary: {percent: 3, duration: 15m}
batching: {enabled: true, max_batch_size: 8}
```

sre-oncall: Add rollback SLOs — if 5xx rate >1.5% or latency p95 > 2x baseline for 10m, auto rollback.

maria: Approving with that rollback thresholds. Also ensure release notes snippet and customer-facing message.

devon: Release notes snippet (customer): "Minor inference perf changes; quantized variant r-quant-8 with fallback to r-fp16. Expected cost savings ~12%. If you see quality regressions, contact support@redwood.ai"

devon: Internal release note:
- pin infra v2.14.3
- kernel k1 selection
- canary config above
- rollback thresholds as SRE

polly: @maria deploybot checklist: run smoke tests, kms key check, metrics hook registered

maria: @polly run smoke now?

polly: running smoke...
polly: smoke OK: latency p50 22ms, p95 88ms, 0 failures

devon: final ask — set canary traffic route to dedicated pool 'bluecrest-dedicated-1' and enable kv-cache priming

devon: kv priming command:
```bash
deployctl prime-kv --tenant bluecrest --keys recent-prompts --workers 4
```

ana: KMS conflict resolved w/ customer; key rotation postponed until after next minor patch.

maria: Signed-off. @deploybot please proceed at scheduled time. :thumbsup:

deploybot: [deploybot] Kickoff at 2025-06-12T22:00:00Z — canary 3% -> 25% -> cutover.

deploybot: [deploybot] Canary stage done (3% 15m). Metrics: 5xx=0.2%, p95=1.05x baseline.

deploybot: [deploybot] Canary 25% started.

deploybot: [deploybot] Cutover complete. Traffic at 100%. No rollback triggered.

maria: Nice. Please attach final release notes to customer ticket #BC-4321.

devon: attached. Closing thread.
